text:
oncall-rotation: quick heads-up — I'm primary for tonight but delayed at the airport, ETA 45-60m. requesting emergency swap if someone can cover the first hour. tagging @jamal @maria. :airplane:
jamal: I can take primary for the first 45m. Can someone be secondary? I don't have the recent routing changes in my head.
maria: I can be secondary for the window. jamal — you good with runbook links?
jamal: yep. pls paste runbook pointers. also, is there any active paging?
incident-bot: [ALERT] 2468013500 - partial degradation: embeddings service 503s for subset of eu-west requests (10% error rate). triggered at 2026-03-14T01:05:00Z.
sre-bot: Noted. alert routed to primary pager. Current primary (oncall-rotation) not acknowledged.
alex: pinging infra team — I'm online and can help with failover if needed. jamal: you should have permissions for the routing toggle (infra-console -> traffic -> model-proxy).
jamal: thanks @alex. Maria, can you hold secondary for incident comms (customer updates + internal notes)?
maria: yup. I'll open a public incident channel if this looks customer-facing. initial impact: embeddings 503 for eu-west customers on dedicated/dedicated-like routes. Might affect downstream search features.
jamal: OK switching to primary now. taking over pager. giving 1min to ensure alert ack shows as mine.
oncall-rotation: thanks @jamal and @maria — marking primary handoff in rotation bot: `!handoff accept 2468013579->jamal`
oncall-rotation: system: handoff recorded. primary=jamal, secondary=maria, note="delayed arrival for oncall-rotation"
jamal: acked alert. first step: check proxy health and recent deploys — `kubectl get pods -n model-proxy -l app=model-proxy` and `kubectl logs -n model-proxy deploy/model-proxy --since=10m | tail -n 200`
alex: logs show repeated 503s with upstream read timeout to embeddings-backend-2. rolling-restart of proxy might be a quick mitigation if upstream flaps.
maria: I'll draft a short note: "We're investigating 503 errors affecting embeddings in eu-west. We're on-call and triaging; no ongoing mitigation yet." want to post to status.redwood.com?
jamal: hold on mitigation plan: 1) confirm upstream health `curl` to embeddings-backend-2; 2) if backend healthy, toggle traffic to embeddings-backend-1 (80% -> 100%) via infra-console; 3) if backend unhealthy, scale replicas or evict bad nodes. Maria, post PS1 after step 2 if successful.
devon: I'm available to run the traffic toggle if jamal wants a hand. also can spin an emergency scale in the eu-west cluster.
jamal: please do the check now, @devon. paste curl results.
devon: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" http://embeddings-backend-2.internal/health` -> `503 0.12s` - failing health.
jamal: confirms. moving traffic. @devon, please execute toggle and scale to +2 replicas.
devon: executing: `infra-console traffic update --service embeddings --region eu-west --from embeddings-backend-2 --to embeddings-backend-1` -> success. scaling: `kubectl scale deploy embeddings-backend-2 --replicas=5 -n eu-west` -> scaling started.
incident-bot: [UPDATE] action: traffic reroute applied by devon at 2026-03-14T01:12:33Z. error rate dropped to 2% in last 2m.
maria: Posting to status now: "Mitigation in progress: traffic rerouted away from failing backend in eu-west. Error rates decreasing. We’ll update in 15 minutes."
jamal: monitoring tail logs and SLO dashboards. if error rate <1% for 10m, we'll close PS1 and return to normal. Also, once stable, we should record root cause steps in the runbook.
oncall-rotation: reminder: primary change logged. when original primary (oncall-rotation) arrives, run `!handoff complete jamal->oncall-rotation` to return.
maria: small note — because this was during a handoff window, please add a line in the incident notes about the swap and who executed mitigation for audit.
jamal: will add. final ask: @oncall-rotation when you land, ping to do formal handback and confirm you saw the incident timeline.
oncall-rotation: thanks everyone — ETA updated to 40m now. safe travels and thanks @jamal @maria @devon for stepping in. :thumbsup:
